member.summary: Signed claims inside a licence key.

member.name: T:LeadPilot.Infrastructure.Licensing.LicenseCodec
member.summary: Offline licence format: LPAI1-<base64url payload>.<base64url ECDSA-P256 signature>. Only the vendor holds the private key.

member.name: T:LeadPilot.Infrastructure.Licensing.LicenseService
member.summary: Offline licence validation, kept apart from application logic. Trial: 14 days from first run, 200 leads, 1 user. Paid keys are signed by the vendor (ECDSA P-256); the app contains only the public key, so keys cannot be forged from the installed files. The trial start is stored in two places and the earlier date wins; like any offline trial this deters casual resets, not determined ones.

member.summary: Creates the service; overrides the embedded vendor key (tests).

member.name: T:LeadPilot.Infrastructure.Logging.FileLoggerProvider
member.summary: Writes one log file per day under the Logs folder and deletes files older than 14 days. Never logs secrets or lead contents.

member.name: T:LeadPilot.Infrastructure.Security.BackupService
member.summary: Backs up the database as a zip (manifest + consistent SQLite copy). With a password the zip is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, key derived by PBKDF2-SHA256 (600 000 iterations, random salt). Restore verifies integrity and keeps a safety copy first.

member.name: T:LeadPilot.Infrastructure.Security.SecretStore
member.summary: Stores API keys encrypted at rest. On Windows each value is protected with DPAPI (current-user scope, so other Windows accounts and copied files cannot read it). On other platforms (development/tests) AES-GCM with a key file is used.
